outOfScope: Global organization scheduling, role sequencing or next-domain dispatch.
Generic event-sourcing platform, universal provenance database or organization-wide telemetry ledger.
Mandatory Certificate Transparency, Merkle-tree inclusion proofs or external transparency-log infrastructure.
Implementation of terminal Blackboard DONE reopening; Integration G v1 uses immutable historical closure plus current projection/revalidation semantics.
Adversarial recovery benchmark, causal observability and self-improvement loops reserved for later Integration H through J.
constraints: Caller-selected current refs are not completeness proof.
ProductHistoryHead is a product-completeness/currentness subject, not an organization scheduler, execution log or observability stream.
ProductStateProjection is not product authority and is never directly mutated as truth.
A stable product state cannot expose a newer authoritative closure-relevant transition while the canonical completeness head still commits only to an older state.
Historical ProductOutcomeClaim is not a permanent current DONE bit.
Acceptance-policy and applicable-waiver currentness are derived from canonical authority and pinned in the projection subject rather than accepted as a convenient caller subset.
Execution-policy or execution-strategy changes alone do not change product readiness unless accepted product semantic lineage changes.

Cryptographic Merkle inclusion/consistency proofs are not required for Integration G v1; exact generation/digest commitment and durable CAS/recovery are sufficient for the current trusted-store threat model.
